description.value:
You form a transparent wall of hardlight featuring payment terms in many languages. Each 10-foot-by-10-foot section of the wall has AC 10, Hardness 18, and 60 Hit Points, and its immune to critical hits and precision damage. The wall can be passed through by paying 10 credits and verifying the transaction as an single action with the auditory trait. Creatures that carry a credstick can pass, even if its empty, though in this case they pass through by taking on 10 credits of debt.

Heightened (+1) The Hit Points of each section of the wall increase by 15.
